title: Compiled expression effects
statement: Let a word size, compiler size parameters, state, stack position, and memory satisfy the framed-state conditions: the designated constants, pool, frame pointer, local-variable cells, and valid memory cells encode the given state, and the stack position is within bounds. For an expression $e$ and temporary index $k$, suppose $e$ uses at most $F$ variables, is safe under the state and limits, and $k + \mathrm{height}(e) \le 2F+1$. Executing the compiled expression writes its value into temporary cell $k$ and leaves memory unchanged outside the set consisting of the address scratch cell and temporary cells indexed from $k$ through $2F$.
hypotheses_covered: A framed initial memory and state, including its relation and stack bounds
Expression safety under the limits and state
